# Release v2.0.0

**Breaking release.** Removes all deprecated APIs scheduled for v2.0 and cleans up the internal event-emission machinery that existed only to preserve backwards-compatible event ordering. This is the first task of the v2.0 cycle; the AI opponent and ranking stub will ship on top of the cleaned-up API.

---

## Changelog

## [2.0.0] - 2026-08-18

### Removed (breaking)

- `GameOptions.boardSize` — use `variant` instead. Arbitrary board sizes are no longer accepted; only predefined variants are supported.
- `Game.savePlayerSelection(field)` — use `savePlayerMove(index)` (0-based index) instead.
- `Game.isFieldSelected(field)` — use `isFieldSelectedByIndex(index)` instead.
- `Game.getBoard()` — use the `board` getter instead.
- `Board.getFieldByNumber(fieldNumber)` — use `getFieldByIndex(index)` instead.
- `Board.setFieldByNumber(fieldNumber, symbol)` — use `setFieldByIndex(index, symbol)` instead.
- `GameEvent.PLAYER_MOVE` and `GameEvent.RESET` events — use `STATE_CHANGE` for all state updates. `STATE_CHANGE` is now the only emitted event and fires after every `savePlayerMove`, `backToMove`, and `reset`.
- `GameEventMap` entries for `PLAYER_MOVE` and `RESET`.
- Internal `Game._safeEmit` / `Game._rethrowCollected` helpers and the `AggregateError` re-throw path — they existed only to preserve emission ordering between the deprecated `PLAYER_MOVE`/`RESET` events. With a single `STATE_CHANGE` event, listener errors now propagate directly from the emitting method, matching the previous single-event behavior.
- `resolveGameStrategy` no longer validates a `boardSize` option; the `validateBoardSize` helper is gone.
- Tests covering the removed deprecated APIs.

### Changed

- `GameEvent` now contains only `STATE_CHANGE`.
- `IGame` interface no longer declares `savePlayerSelection`, `isFieldSelected`, or `getBoard`.
- `IBoard` interface no longer declares `getFieldByNumber` or `setFieldByNumber`.
- `Game` constructor JSDoc updated to reflect that only `variant` is accepted.
- `README.md` API table and events section updated to remove deprecated entries.
- `src/PLAN-v2.0.md` updated: deprecated-API removal is now marked as done (first task of the v2.0 cycle).

### Migration

| v1.x (removed) | v2.0 replacement |
| -------------- | ---------------- |
| `new Game({ boardSize: 9 })` | `new Game({ variant: GameVariant.CLASSIC_3X3 })` or `new Game()` |
| `game.savePlayerSelection(field)` (1-9) | `game.savePlayerMove(index)` (0-8) |
| `game.isFieldSelected(field)` (1-9) | `game.isFieldSelectedByIndex(index)` (0-8) |
| `game.getBoard()` | `game.board` |
| `board.getFieldByNumber(n)` (1-9) | `board.getFieldByIndex(i)` (0-8) |
| `board.setFieldByNumber(n, s)` (1-9) | `board.setFieldByIndex(i, s)` (0-8) |
| `GameEvent.PLAYER_MOVE` / `GameEvent.RESET` | `GameEvent.STATE_CHANGE` |
